deadChecking.description: Progress line of the palette's dead-link scan mode; $done$ bookmarks checked out of $total$.

deadConfirmAll.description: Confirmation before batch-deleting every dead bookmark from the scan results. $count$ is the number of dead bookmarks.
deadConfirmAll.message: Delete all $count$ dead bookmarks? This cannot be undone in one step.

deadConfirmDelete.description: Confirmation before deleting one bookmark from the palette's dead-link scan results.

deadDeleteAll.description: Top row of the palette's dead-link scan results; deletes every dead bookmark in one batch. $count$ is the total.

deadNone.description: Empty-state line of the palette's dead-link scan mode, shown when every bookmark checked out fine.

deadRescan.description: Top row of the palette's dead-link scan results; starts the scan over.

deletedBookmark.description: Toast shown after a bookmark or separator was deleted; the toast offers an undo button. $title$ is the deleted row's title (empty for separators).

deletedFolder.description: Toast shown after a bookmark folder (with its whole subtree) was deleted; the toast offers an undo button. $title$ is the folder name.

undoAction.description: Label of the undo button on the deletion toast.

dupesCleanAll.description: Top row of the palette's duplicate-cleanup mode; removes every redundant copy in one go.

dupesConfirmAll.description: Confirmation before deleting every redundant copy across all duplicate groups (each group keeps its oldest bookmark).
dupesConfirmAll.message: Remove $count$ extra copies across $groups$ groups? Oldest entries are kept.

dupesConfirmGroup.description: Confirmation before deleting the redundant copies of one duplicate group (the oldest bookmark is kept).
dupesConfirmGroup.message: Keep the oldest and remove the other $count$ copies?

dupesDone.description: Alert shown after the duplicate cleanup finished.

dupesGroupCount.description: Suffix on a duplicate-group row in the command palette: how many bookmarks share the normalized URL.

dupesNone.description: Empty-state line of the palette's duplicate-cleanup mode.

donationMessage.message: If you like it, maybe you can donate for its future development. Any amount is welcome.

paletteCmdQuickAdd.description: Command palette entry that bookmarks the current tab (same as the star button).
